name: Evenfall
source:
Evenfall is known as the city of eternal sunset—an ex-mining colony where the sun hangs motionless below the horizon. Countless robots eke out a living under its flickering streetlights. One day, all of the city's outgoing communication goes dark.

When intrepid technician Indigo is sent to diagnose the issue, they quickly hit it off with the locals. They've always preferred the company of machines over their fellow humans, and the cuties at the local bar are no exception.

But with megacorporate support dwindling, Evenfall is on the brink of collapse. As Indigo digs into the city's secrets, they uncover a conspiracy that might finally spell an end to the twilit metropolis—with Indigo caught in the middle.

[From [url=https://nivrad00.itch.io/evenfall]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
傍晚被称为永恒日落之城——一个前采矿殖民地，太阳一动不动地悬挂在地平线以下。无数的机器人在闪烁的路灯下勉强维持生计。有一天，该市所有的对外通讯都陷入了瘫痪。

当勇敢的技术人员Indigo被派去诊断问题时，他们很快与当地人一拍即合。他们总是更喜欢机器的陪伴而不是人类同伴，当地酒吧里的可爱们也不例外。

但随着大企业支持的减少，Evenfall正处于崩溃的边缘。当靛蓝深入挖掘这座城市的秘密时，他们发现了一个阴谋，最终可能会终结这座暮色大都市，而靛蓝则被夹在中间。

[来自[url=https://nivrad00.itch.io/evenfall]Itch.io[/url]]
